topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: They say all good things come to an end, but that doesn’t make it any easier to swallow. Found out today that the place I’ve been frequenting for years is packing up its last bits of flair. Just when you think you’ve found a spot that’s going to stick around, it’s announced they’re calling it quits. They probably cite economic reasons, rent, whatever. Meanwhile, I’m left to ponder where I’ll go to find that same comfort, that same bowl of soup that felt like a warm hug. Guess I’ll have to find a new haunt, or maybe just accept that some things are irreplaceable. Not sure I’m ready for that, but what choice do I have?
